title: Miner dies as SUV plunges into Benguet ravine after leaving wake

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — A 29-year-old miner died after the sport utility vehicle he was driving plunged into an 80-meter-deep ravine in Sitio Urica, Barangay Ampucao at the Benguet mining town of Itogon on Friday morning, Sept. 25.
